form: E_step = e0 + e_d*n_decode_reqs + e_kv*total_KV + e_p*n_prefill_tokens (+ e_pr*n_prefill_reqs)

timing.note: a0/a1 fit on this campaign's own prefill blocks, c0 on its decode blocks. e_p/a1 is the prefill marginal power and should sit just under engine_tdp_w; if it exceeds it, suspect the timing fit before the energy model.

provenance.engine: vLLM 0.6.3, chunked prefill off, enforce_eager, fp16, seed 42
provenance.instrument: NVML power.draw at 20 Hz, energy counter cross-check
provenance.note: Coefficients are for qwen2.5_7B at TP=2 and cover a whole 2-GPU engine. Do NOT rescale them to another TP. That was tested: at TP=2 the per-GPU ratios against TP=1 are 0.736 (e0), 0.713 (e_d), 0.366 (e_kv) and 0.628 (e_p) -- none of them 1.0 -- so dividing by the device count reproduces none of them. Across ARCHITECTURES the form and its coefficients do transfer: the prefill plateau is the card's TDP, e_p is plateau x a1, and e_kv follows KV bytes per token to about 20%.
